description: The file defines the SkillService class, which provides business logic for managing Skill entities, including methods for saving, retrieving, deleting, and searching skills. It acts as a service layer that interacts with the SkillDao data access object.

classes.name: SkillService
classes.description: Provides services for managing Skill entities, including CRUD operations and search functionalities, with exception handling.

methods.name: getSkillDao
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns the SkillDao instance used by this service.

methods.name: setSkillDao
methods.description: Sets a specific SkillDao instance, useful for dependency injection.

methods.name: saveSkill
methods.description: Saves a Skill entity to the database via the DAO.

methods.name: getSkillById
methods.description: Retrieves a Skill by its ID.

methods.name: deleteSkills
methods.description: Deletes multiple Skills based on an array of IDs.

methods.name: searchSkill
methods.description: Performs a search for Skills based on provided filter parameters; throws ServiceException on failure.

methods.name: getSearchSkillsCount
methods.description: Returns the count of Skills matching the search filter; throws ServiceException on failure.
